_meta.description: The campaign ledger. It starts empty and well-defined: a row is added only when the figures are obtained from an authorized first-party report. No conversion score and no revenue forecast is presented here or anywhere on this site.

columns.meaning: The authorized first-party report the figures were read from, named and linked.
Where the report says the traffic came from (organic search, direct, feed, and so on). Never inferred.
Sessions the report attributes to this site's Special Links.
Clicks the report attributes to this site's links.
Orders the report attributes to this site's links.
Dated provenance trail: report name, report period, retrieval session, and the commit the row landed in.

_meta.provenance_rule: A row without a named first-party report, a report period and a retrieval date is invalid. Figures are copied exactly as the report states them; nothing is estimated, interpolated, modelled or forecast. A later report that revises an earlier figure is added as a new row with its own provenance, never by editing the old row.
_meta.why_empty: No Associates account or reporting feed is connected (Q-01, Q-48, F-19), so no authorized figure exists to put in a row. The ledger is defined now so that measurement, when it arrives, lands in one agreed shape.

sources.ref: Commission Income Statement, Sections 1 to 3: Amazon creates and distributes the click and order reports
Operating Agreement Section 4: no representation about the traffic or commission income a site can expect
